claims.text: Henry Moore Grants support the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers.
Henry Moore Grants fund research expanding the appreciation of sculpture.

Categories covered by the grants include exhibitions, exhibition catalogues, commissions, acquisitions, conservation, cataloguing, display, conferences, lectures, non-commercial publications, long-term research, and research/travel.
Applications are considered four times per year.
Applications are submitted via Flexi-Grant.
The grants are available to UK and international non-profit organisations.
Individual sculpture historians, academics, and conservators can apply to the Research and Travel category.
Individuals wishing to create, inform, develop, or research their own practice are not eligible.
Community project applications are only considered when the applicant is a non-profit arts organisation.
The maximum grant available for New Projects and Commissions is £20,000.
The maximum grant available for Acquisitions and Collections is £20,000.
The maximum grant available for Conferences, Lectures and Publications is £5,000.
The maximum grant available for Long-Term Research grants is £20,000.
The maximum grant available for Research and Travel grants is £2,500.
Applications for the Autumn round close on September 1st, 23:00.
Projects funded in the Autumn round must start or open to the public no sooner than January 1st, 2027.
Applications for the Winter round open on November 1st, 9:00.
Applications for the Winter round close on December 1st, 23:00.
Projects funded in the Winter round must start or open to the public no sooner than April 1st, 2027.
Applications for the Spring round open on February 1st, 2027, 9:00.
Applications for the Spring round close on March 1st, 2027, 23:00.
Projects funded in the Spring round must start or open to the public no sooner than July 1st, 2027.
Applications for the Summer round open on May 1st, 2027, 9:00.
Applications for the Summer round close on June 1st, 2027, 23:00.
Projects funded in the Summer round must start or open to the public no sooner than October 1st, 2027.
Organisations must be registered to apply.
Registration requests must be received one week before the deadline.
The Artist Award Scheme is not a grant that can be applied for.
Recipients of the Artist Award Scheme are selected through a UK-wide nomination process.
